title: MONSTER V5 Step 5 - Zero-Context Resume Packet
scope: Create one repository-backed, tamper-evident zero-context resume packet that lets a brand-new chat or worker recover the mission, exact program step, completed/frozen/remaining steps, authoritative main/head snapshot, authoritative async run and state, last completed action, blocker, only legal next action, full frozen-checkpoint set, continuation-layer identities, and exact proof receipt without reconstructing chat history. The packet is context only and never grants mutation authority; Step 2A plus a valid scope-aware lease remain mandatory.
proof_policy: Exact PR head must pass permanent DevSystem contract and final gate, merge through the single Step-5 PR, merged-main DevSystem proof and terminal receipt must pass, MONSTER_V5_STEP5 must be content-addressed in the frozen registry, only the Step-5 scope lease may be released, the dedicated zero-context resume packet ref must be published from final frozen state, and final truth must publish Step 5 FROZEN with MONSTER_V5_COMPLETE.
